sloka: चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं षष्टियोजनमायतम् ।तथैव हनुमान्वीरः सप्ततीयोजिनोच्छ्रितः ॥५-१-१६५॥
transliteration: cakāra surasā vaktraṁ ṣaṣṭiyojanamāyatam ।tathaiva hanumānvīraḥ saptatīyojinocchritaḥ ॥5-1-165॥

translations.english: Surasa widened her mouth sixty yojanas and then the heroic Hanuman enlarged himself to seventy yojanas.
